
Make sure you understand everything in the project:
- src folder will generate files using StewBeet & Beet
- assets folder contains assets
- build folder is the result of the build, never modify it
- If you need to understand minecraft vanilla behavior, the decompiled source code is in "minecraft_source_code" folder (a git link with no `.gitmodules` entry, so a fresh clone gets it empty: decompile 26.3 into it locally)
- based_of folder is the old code (1.19, we are in 26.3 now) : we keep it because it can always come handy if we are missing a feature.

To build the project, type `stewbeet` and verify output in build.
